text:
Rae: Quick note  Austin LLM Afterwork confirmed Oct 7. We have a tabletop + 6-min lightning demo. Need owners: talk submit, demo script, swag pack, shipping, lead capture. Shipping cutoff Sep 28. Who can take speaker submission today?

Hector: I can do the submission. Will condense our cost/latency narrative into a 5-slide deck + 90s live demo. Any constraints from the meetup org?

ops-bot: Meetup rules: 6 slides max for lightning talks, no live API keys on stage. Slides and bio due 72h before event.

Mina: I'll own swag packs. Idea: 200 stickers, 80 seed-packet "grow-your-model" cards, 60 lanyards. Vendor: austin-merch.co. PO #PO-7225. ETA Oct 1. Lanyards add $220 — ok within budget if we trim stickers to 180.

Jules: I'll handle AV and be onsite lead. Need 13" monitor, HDMI, 2 clip mics, battery pack, gaffer tape. Also can receive shipments if needed.

Pri: Lead capture plan: QR -> short Google Form (keeps it simple) + badge scanner fallback. Form webhook -> Zapier -> HubSpot list "Austin Afterwork" -> assign to Jules for 48h -> SDR rotation. Jules, can you own the first-touch follow-up?

Jules: Yep. I can do follow-ups. Please include utm params on the QR link. Also prefer speaker bio + 1-line summary for the host page.

Rae: Decision: stickers 180, seed-cards 80, lanyards 60. Mina finalize PO. I'll update the event sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1austin-afterwork-plan (shipping rows).

Hector: Adding utm now: ?utm_source=austin_afterwork&utm_campaign=oct7_demo. Will upload a short demo video as fallback (no live keys).

Mina: Ordered. Vendor confirmed hold-for-pickup at venue. Tracking AM998877. PO uploaded. Will pack 2 spare lanyards per table.

Rae: One-pager idea: micro-benchmark (2-token baseline vs 1k-tail) + 3 quick integration tips + a tiny checklist for infra teams. Pri  can you draft copy by Sep 20?

Pri: Yep. Will keep it 1-sided and printer-friendly. Need latest perf pngs.

ops-bot: Perf artifact: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/austin_oct7_tail.png

Jules: Shipping notes: venue requires a name + phone number for pickup. I'll be the recipient on the manifest. Also confirm table layout: monitor center, seed-cards front, stickers top-right, swag bags under table.

Mina: Confirmed pickup name Jules / Redwood Inference. I'll DM the courier. Also prepping 50 raffle slips with QR for follow-ups.

Rae: Dry run Sep 30 @ 10am CT. Recap owners: Hector = submission + demo + fallback clip, Mina = swag + shipping, Jules = AV + onsite + follow-ups, Pri = one-pager + copy, Rae = runbook + calendar invites. Zapier mapping for reference:
```
trigger: google_forms_submission
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts
payload: {"properties": {"email": "{{email}}", "utm_source": "austin_afterwork", "owner": "Jules"}}
```
Rae: Please update the sheet when you have uploads. :rocket:
